name: Self-order mobile cart screen
describe: Full-screen cart: header with "← Back to menu", centred "Your Cart" and a w-[92px] spacer; rounded-lg line cards with 28px −/+ steppers and an optional "Note:" line; footer with item count, total and "Proceed to checkout".
Reached from the fixed "View Cart" bar. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
